blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: . Single-image scene generation aims to produce a complete 3D scene mesh from a single image, including surfaces the camera did not observe. While pretrained 3D object generators encode a strong shape prior, they are mainly designed for isolated objects in a fixed canonical volume and focus mostly on indoor scenes, since diverse 3D data for outdoor scenes are quite limited. In this work, we present a method that redesigns such an object-centric generator, e.g. , Trellis 2, to work on both indoor and outdoor scenes while retaining its prior. We accomplish this by (a) partitioning the scene into adaptive chunks that scale relative to the distance to the camera; nearby chunks have a smaller size to keep the finer detail, while distant structures, e.g. , buildings, are covered by large chunks; (b) making the generator capture explicit 2D–3D correspondence by lifting image features and making the model aware of the free space, observed surface, and unobserved region; (c) synthesizing around 4,000 outdoor scenes to broaden the training data, as existing scene datasets are largely indoor. Experiments on Tanks and Temples, ScanNet++, and in-the-wild images show that our method outperforms all baselines in geometric accuracy and perceptual quality across both indoor and outdoor scenes.
blocks.zh: 。 。 。 。 单相相片场景生成旨在从单一相片中产生完整的3D相片网格,包括相机没有观测到的表面. 虽然预先训练的3D物体发生器在前作中编码了强烈的外形,但它们主要是为固定的犬形体积中被隔离的物体所设计,并主要专注于室内场景,因为户外场景的多种3D数据相当有限. 在这项工作中,我们提出了一种方法,即重新设计这种以物体为中心的发电机,例如Trellis 2,以便在室内和室外的场景上工作,同时保留其前作。 我们通过以下方式完成这项工作:(a) 将场景划分成适应性块,相对于相机的相距范围;附近块的尺寸较小,以保持更细细的细节,而遥远的结构,例如建筑物,则被大块所覆盖;(b) 通过提升图像特性并让模型了解自由空间、观测到的地表和无人观察的区域,使发电机能够清晰地捕捉到2D-3D通信;(c) 合成大约4 000个室外场景,以扩大培训数据,因为现有的场景数据集基本上都在室内。 在Tanks and Temples、ScanNet++上的实验,以及无所不包的图像显示,我们的方法在几何精确度和感知质量上超越了室内外场景的所有基线。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: We propose a method for generating a complete 3D scene mesh from a single image. This is a long-standing problem in computer vision and graphics with applications in content creation, virtual reality, and robotics. This task has gained new relevance with world models that turn a single image into an explorable 3D world ( HY-World et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) , reducing the need for extensive capture. Such worlds can be used in a physics simulator for robot navigation and interaction ( Shen et al., 2026 ) to scale up robot learning ( Nasiriany et al., 2024 ; Nasiriany et al., 2026 ) . Different from multi-view reconstruction, generating a scene from a single image requires not only estimating the depth and shape of the visible surfaces, but also completing the geometry unobserved behind them.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个方法,从一个单一的图像中生成一个完整的3D场景网. 这是计算机视觉和图形中长期存在的问题,在内容创建,虚拟现实,机器人方面都有应用. 这项任务随着世界模型将单一图像转化为可探索的3D世界而获得了新的相关性(HY-World等,2026;Shen等,2026),减少了广泛捕捉的需求. 这类世界可以被用在用于机器人导航和相互作用的物理模拟器中(沈等,2026年)来扩大机器人学习(纳西里安等,2024年;纳西里安等,2026年). 与多景重建不同,从一幅相片中产生出一幕,不仅需要估计可见地表的深度和形状,还需要完成后方未观测到的几何.

blocks.en: Recent approaches to single-image scene generation leverage 2D generative priors by distilling into a 3D representation ( Sargent et al., 2024 ) , iteratively inpainting and lifting novel views ( Höllein et al., 2023 ) , or generating views or videos that are then reconstructed into 3D ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) . Feedforward 3D generators ( Xiang et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) trained on large object collections have been extended to indoor scenes by composing per-object generations ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Meng et al., 2026 ) or by predicting scene-level geometry directly ( Schmid et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . However, learning a scene-level generative prior remains difficult as diverse 3D scene data are limited. Unlike the large asset collections behind object generators ( Deitke et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , scene datasets ( Dai et al., 2017 ; Fu et al., 2021 ; Xia et al., 2026 ) focus on indoor scenes, and procedural generators ( Raistrick et al., 2023 ) where the outdoor scenes’ diversity is limited by hand-crafted rules and asset generators. Training a model that handles the layouts, structures, and viewpoints of general scenes therefore remains difficult.

blocks.en: We present a novel method building upon Trellis 2 ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) for scene reconstruction while inheriting its learned prior on objects. To better handle this task, our method redesigns Trellis 2 by explicitly imposing 2D–3D correspondences using a monocular point map as geometric conditioning. This raises three technical challenges: (a) representing scenes whose physical extent far exceeds an object’s canonical volume, (b) keeping the generated geometry faithful to the observed image, and (c) training with limited outdoor scene data. We address these as follows.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了在Trellis 2(Xiang等,2026年)基础上建立的新方法,用于现场重建,同时继承它在物体上之前学到的知识。 为了更好地处理这项任务,我们的方法重新设计了Trellis 2,明确规定使用单点图作为几何条件的2D-3D通信. 这提出了三个技术挑战:(a) 代表物理范围远超过物体罐头体积的场景;(b) 使生成的几何学与所观察到的图像保持一致;(c) 利用有限的室外场景数据进行培训。 我们的处理方式如下。

blocks.en:
First, we represent a scene with adaptive chunks whose physical scale varies across the scene. Fitting an entire scene into the generator’s fixed-resolution volume sacrifices detail, while fixed-size chunks ( Schmid et al., 2026 ) require many generations to cover a large scene. Under perspective projection, distant regions occupy fewer pixels, so we use smaller chunks nearby to preserve detail and larger chunks for distant regions to extend coverage. Second, we condition each 3D voxel on the image through explicit 2D–3D correspondence. Using an estimated point map, we lift image features ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) only onto the observed surface and encode whether each token lies in free space in front of the surface, on it, or in the unknown region behind it. This indicates to the model where to reconstruct and where to generate.
Third, we construct around 4,000 diverse outdoor scenes with a synthetic pipeline and train on them together with existing indoor datasets. While the outdoor scenes are not perfect reconstructions, we found, somewhat surprisingly, that training on them improves the model’s performance.
blocks.zh:
首先,我们代表的场景有适应性的块块,其物理尺度在全场各有不同. 将整个场景拼入发电机的固定分辨率体积会牺牲细节,而固定尺寸块(Schmid等,2026年)则需要多代人来覆盖一个大场景. 在远景预测中,相距遥远的区域占用了较少的像素,所以我们用附近的较小块来保存细节和更大的块来使相距遥远的区域扩大覆盖范围. 第二,我们通过明确的2D–3D通信在图像上附加每个3D voxel. 使用估计的点图,我们只将图像特征(Siméoni等,2025年)提升到被观测到的地表,并编码出每个地物是否位于地表前方的自由空间,是否位于地表后方的未知区域. 这向模型表明重建地点和生成地点。
第三,我们用合成管道建造了大约4 000个不同的室外场景,并连同现有的室内数据集对其进行培训。 虽然户外的场景并不是完美的重建,但我们发现,有点令人惊讶的是,关于这些场景的培训提高了模型的性能。

blocks.en: Empirically, we achieve strong performance in single-image reconstruction over baselines. Fig. 1 shows reconstructions of indoor, outdoor, and large-scale scenes, including the Colosseum viewed from multiple viewpoints. We evaluate against baselines on Tanks and Temples ( Knapitsch et al., 2017 ) , ScanNet++ ( Yeshwanth et al., 2023 ) , and 121 in-the-wild images, and our method outperforms all baselines on every metric. On Tanks and Temples, it reduces Chamfer distance by 24% and improves F1 by 30% over the strongest baseline on each metric, and on in-the-wild images it is preferred over every baseline in at least 73% of pairwise user-study comparisons. Our adaptive chunking also runs three times faster than fixed-size chunking while improving reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh: 从经验上讲,我们在基线基础上的单一图像重建取得了强劲的业绩。 图一显示室内、室外和大规模场景的重建情况,包括从多个角度观察的Colosseum。 我们对照Tanks和Temples的基线(Knapitsch等,2017年),ScanNet++(Yeshwanth等,2023年),以及121个零星图像进行评估,我们的方法在每一公尺上都超过了所有基线。 在Tanks和Temples上,它将Chamfer的距离减少了24%,将F1比每个公尺上最强的基线提高30%,在至少73%的对等用户-研究比较中,它比每个基线更受欢迎。 我们的适应性块也比固定尺寸块快三倍,同时提高重建质量。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are: • Adaptive scene chunks. We introduce a chunk-based scene representation whose physical scale changes across the scene. Nearby regions use smaller chunks to preserve detail, while farther or taller regions use larger chunks to extend scene coverage, so that one generator trained on a canonical volume can cover scenes of varying extent. • Explicit 2D–3D conditioning. We propose a scene mesh generation model that explicitly distinguishes 3D locations supported by the observation from unobserved regions, allowing reconstruction and generative completion to be handled within a unified model. • Outdoor scene supervision. We construct around 4,000 diverse outdoor scenes to create additional training supervision. The model trained on them produces better reconstructions at inference time than the scene-generation framework used to create the dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是: 我们引入了一个以块为主的场景代表,其物理尺度在全场都有所变化. 相邻区域使用较小块来保存细节,而更远或更高的区域使用较大的块来扩大场景覆盖范围,这样,一个受过犬科卷训练的发电机可以覆盖不同程度的场景. • 明确的2D-3D条件。 我们提出了一个场景网状生成模型,明确区分观测所支持的3D位置与未观测区域,允许在统一的模型中处理重建和基因完成. 二. 支助 户外现场监督. 我们建造了大约4 000个不同的室外场景,以建立更多的培训监督。 对他们进行训练的模型在推断时产生的重建效果比用于创建数据集的场景生成框架要好.

blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: Figure 2. Overview of our method. (a) Scene representation. We lift the input image using an estimated point map and partition the scene into adaptive 3D chunks. (b) Chunk generation. For each chunk, the generator first predicts the sparse structure and then its structured geometry latents. Both stages are conditioned on surface-aligned lifted image features, while the first stage further receives a depth-based visibility indicator to distinguish free space vs. occluded regions. (c) Autoregressive scene generation. We generate neighboring chunks sequentially while reusing latents in overlapping regions, allowing each new chunk to complete unseen geometry conditioned on the previously generated scene chunk. The assembled latents are finally decoded into the full scene mesh.
blocks.zh: 图 2. 我们的方法概述。 (a) 场景代表。 我们利用一个估计的点图来提升输入图像,然后将场景分割成适应性的3D块. (b) 春克一代。 对于每个块,生成器首先预测出稀疏的结构,然后预测其结构化的几何潜质. 两个阶段都以地表相通的被升起的图像特征为条件,而第一阶段则进一步获得一个深度能见度指标,以区别自由空间与被占用区域. (c) 自动后退场景生成。 我们依次生成相邻的块,同时在相重叠的区域再使用潜伏物,使每个新块能够完成以前产生的场景块所附带的不见的几何条件. 组装的潜伏物最终被解码入整个场景网.

blocks.en:
Scene generation with image and video priors. A line of work reconstructs 3D scenes by leveraging pretrained 2D generative models. Diffusion distillation optimizes a 3D representation under image-generation priors ( Sargent et al., 2024 ; Poole et al., 2022 ) , enabling novel-view synthesis from limited observations, but it requires costly per-scene optimization. Iterative lifting and inpainting instead alternates between rendering the current reconstruction, synthesizing unobserved regions, and lifting them back into 3D ( Höllein et al., 2023 ) . Such pipelines can progressively expand a scene, but errors in inpainting and geometric registration may accumulate across iterations ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
More recent generate-then-reconstruct approaches generate multi-view images and reconstruct them into a 3D scene ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; HY-World et al., 2026 ) , which could improve consistency, but reconstruction quality depends on both cross-view consistency and whether the chosen viewpoints sufficiently reveal occluded geometry.
In contrast, our method predicts scene geometry directly from the input image without first synthesizing a set of novel views.

volume. Compositional methods extend them to scenes by decomposing an image into

This formulation works naturally for separable instances, but is less suited to

new geometry to be repeatedly reconciled with the existing scene. We instead
learn scene-level consistency from training, enabling more robust generation.

blocks.en: Scene-level generation. Recent methods directly model scenes rather than composing independent objects. GenRecon ( Schmid et al., 2026 ) extends an object prior with overlapping scene chunks, but uses a shared physical scale determined by scene height, creating a tradeoff between scene coverage and local resolution. We instead vary chunk scale across the scene to preserve nearby detail and cover larger structures. Other methods focus on how scene geometry is represented or conditioned. RecGen ( Zadaianchuk et al., 2026 ) integrates point maps into image features, SAM 3D ( Chen et al., 2026a ) uses geometric tokens, while layered, point-based, and volumetric methods directly predict visible and hidden scene geometry ( Li et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Ngo et al., 2026 ) . Differently, we exploit the spatial locations of the generator’s 3D tokens to directly condition on the image features, while completing occluded parts in the mesh latent space.
blocks.zh: 场景级一代. 近代方法直接模拟场景,而不是组合出独立的物体. GenRecon (Schmid等, 2026) 扩展一个在相重叠的场景块之前的物体,但使用由场景高度决定的共享物理尺度,在场景覆盖与局部分辨率之间形成取舍. 相反,我们在整个场景中大小不一,以保护附近的细节和覆盖更大的结构。 其他方法侧重于场景几何是如何被表示或被设定条件的. RecGen(Zadaianchuk等,2026年)将点图整合到图像特征中,SAM 3D(Chen等,2026年a)使用几何符号,而分层的,以点为主的和量子的方法直接预测可见和隐藏的场景几何(Li等,2025年a; 张等,2026;陈等,2026b;倪克等,2026. 不同的是,我们利用发电机的3D信号符的空间位置来直接附加图像特性,同时在网状潜在空间中完成被占用的部分。

blocks.en: 3D scene datasets. 3D scene datasets are much smaller and less diverse than the assets used to train object generators. Existing sources include indoor scans and synthetic room datasets such as ScanNet, 3D-FRONT, and SAGE-10k ( Dai et al., 2017 ; Yeshwanth et al., 2023 ; Fu et al., 2021 ; Xia et al., 2026 ) , while Infinigen provides procedurally generated natural environments ( Raistrick et al., 2024 ) . However, outdoor scenes have much greater variation in geometry, scale, and layout. We complement these datasets with outdoor scenes constructed using an agentic framework.
blocks.zh: 三维场景数据集. 3D场景数据集比用于训练对象生成器的资产要小得多,种类也更少. 现有来源包括室内扫描和合成室数据集,如ScanNet,3D-FRONT,和SAGE-10k(Dai等,2017;Yeshwanth等,2023;Fu等,2021;Xia等,2026),而Infinigen则提供程序生成的自然环境(Raistrick等,2024). 然而,户外场景在几何,尺度和布局上的差异要大得多. 我们用室外场景来补充这些数据组,这些场景是用一种代理框架构建的。

blocks.en: 3. Background
blocks.zh: 3个 背景情况

blocks.en:
Trellis 2 ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) is an image-conditioned 3D asset generator trained on object-centric data . Its geometry representation is based on O-Voxels, which store surface information at active voxel locations, while empty voxels are discarded. This representation does not require watertight geometry and supports open surfaces and interior surfaces, making it suitable for scene structures. A VAE encodes O-Voxel features into structured
latents associated with explicit 3D voxel locations. Geometry generation proceeds through two flow-matching models.
The sparse-structure stage generates a coarse latent grid that is
decoded into active voxel locations. The structured-latent stage
then generates geometry latents at these locations, which the
pretrained decoder converts into a mesh. Both stages operate within
the normalized volume [ − 0.5 , 0.5 ] 3 [-0.5,0.5]^{3} . blocks.en: 4. Scene Mesh Generation
blocks.zh: 4.四. 场景网格生成

blocks.en: Problem formulation and challenges. Given a single image, we aim to generate a scene mesh that reconstructs visible surfaces and completes plausible geometry in occluded regions. Scene-level generation requires allocating resolution across large spatial extents, aligning generated geometry with the input observation, and learning from limited scene supervision. These requirements motivate the following three design choices:
blocks.zh: 问题表述和挑战。 基于单一的图像,我们的目标是产生一个场景网,重建可见的地表并完成在被围住的区域内的几何结构。 场景级生成需要跨越大空间范围分配分辨率,使生成的几何与输入观测相配合,并从有限的场景监督中学习. 这些要求提出了以下三个设计选择:

blocks.en:
(a) Scenes span a larger range of physical sizes than individual objects. Representing an entire scene in a single fixed-resolution volume sacrifices local detail as the scene’s physical extent increases.
One could also divide up the scene and scale each chunk to the canonical volume, but this would be inefficient as one would need a sufficiently fine-grained resolution. Hence, we propose adaptive chunks that preserve finer resolution near the camera while increasing coverage where needed (Sec. 4.1 ). (b) Scene generation must remain faithful to the observed image content. As Trellis 2 is trained on centered objects, using it for scene generation leads to the entire scene being generated at the canonical volume’s origin with incorrect layout. For scene generation, the model must place visible surfaces at their observed position and depth, and complete the unobserved geometry. To make this learning efficient, we provide explicit 2D–3D correspondence to the model by lifting image features onto the observed surfaces in a free-space-aware manner (Sec. 4.2 ). (c) This work aims to generate outdoor scenes, but existing datasets offer limited coverage and diversity of such scenes. To broaden the training data, we synthesize outdoor 3D scenes and use them with existing indoor scene datasets to train our model (Sec. 4.3 ).

blocks.en: 4.1. Representing a scene with adaptive chunks
blocks.zh: 4.1. 代表具有适应性的场景

blocks.en: Figure 3. Scene chunking strategies. A single chunk (a) compresses the entire scene into one fixed volume, sacrificing geometric detail, while fixed-size chunks (b) require many chunks to cover large scenes. Our adaptive strategy (c) increases the physical chunk size with depth, preserving finer resolution nearby while efficiently covering distant regions. Best viewed zoomed in.
blocks.zh: 图 3. 场景分割战略。 单块 (a) 将整个场景压缩为一固定体积,牺牲几何细节,而固定体积 (b) 需要多块来覆盖大场景. 我们的适应战略(c) 使物理块深度增加,在附近保持更细的分辨率,同时有效地覆盖遥远的区域。 最受欢迎的放大。

blocks.en: A photo of a scene may contain objects that are close to the camera and ones further away, e.g . , a nearby chair and a building far behind it. Representing both the chair and the building in a fixed volume makes the chair lose most of its details as the chair is scaled relative to the building (Fig. 3 a). One could also represent the scene using a fixed-resolution grid by dividing the scene into overlapping chunks, similar to GenRecon ( Schmid et al., 2026 ) . The overall scene volume is obtained by fitting a rectangular 3D bounding volume to an estimated point map, then splitting it into chunks. However, using the same physical chunk size throughout the scene still leaves a choice between many small predictions or fewer, coarser predictions (Fig. 3 b).
blocks.zh: 一个场景的照片可能包含靠近相机的物体和更远的物体,例如相邻的椅子和后面的一栋建筑. 将椅子和建筑物固定成一卷,使主席失去大部分细节,因为主席比建筑物大(图3a)。 也可以使用固定分辨率网格来代表场景,将场景分为相重叠块,类似于GenRecon(Schmid等,2026年). 整个场景量是通过将一个长方形的三维相接体与一个估计的点图相接而得到的,然后将其分割成块. 然而,在整个场景中使用相同的物理块大小仍然在很多小的或更少的预测,相近的预测(图3b)之间留有选择余地.

blocks.en: Adaptive chunking. We instead let the physical chunk size adapt based on the scene’s geometry. Under perspective projection, a region of the same physical size occupies fewer pixels in the image as its distance from the camera increases. Nearby regions use smaller chunks to preserve local details, while distant regions use larger chunks to cover more space per generation, as shown in Fig. 3 c. At inference time, we use the estimated point map to cover the scene from the camera.
blocks.zh: 适应性块。 相反,我们让物理块大小根据场景几何来适应。 在视角投影下,一个物理大小相同的区域随着相机距离的增加而占用了较少的图像像素. 如图3c所示,相邻区域使用较小块来保存当地细节,而相距较远的区域则使用较大的块来覆盖每代更多的空间。 在推论时间,我们使用估计的点图从相机上来覆盖场景.

blocks.en: We begin with the smallest chunk size wherever the observed height permits. As coverage extends farther away, we double the physical chunk size and increase the scale when needed to accommodate tall structures. Within each region, adjacent chunks overlap by 0.5 ​ m 0.5\,\mathrm{m} in canonical space, corresponding to a physical overlap of 0.5 ​ a i ​ m 0.5a_{i}\,\mathrm{m} . Overlapping chunks provide shared geometry for autoregressive generation. This allocation preserves fine resolution near the camera where possible while allowing distant or tall regions to occupy larger chunks. Appendix A.1 provides more detail and comparisons of chunking strategies. Our chunk allocation therefore depends on both depth and local height, allowing the scene’s coverage to grow without forcing all regions to use the same resolution.

blocks.en: Adaptive chunks just determine where the model generates and the physical resolution used in each region. To generate a chunk, the model would require knowing which parts of its 3D volume are visible in the input image. For a visible surface, the generated geometry should follow the observation. Behind it, the geometry is unobserved and thus should follow the generative prior. We obtain the visible geometric information by using the monocular point map estimated from the input image.

blocks.en: To provide this geometric information to the model, one could consider image conditioning using cross-attention layers. For example, Trellis 2 lets every 3D token attend to the same image features, leaving the model to learn which image regions correspond to each 3D location. Geometry-aware approaches such as RecGen ( Zadaianchuk et al., 2026 ) add point maps into image features, while SAM 3D ( Chen et al., 2026a ) introduces additional geometry tokens through cross-attention.

blocks.en:
Training scene generation requires mesh ground-truth that includes the full geometry, even those not visible in the input image view. For this, we use SAGE-10k ( Xia et al., 2026 ) , which contains 10,000 10{,}000 indoor scenes generated with each of Infinigen 1.0 and 2.0 ( Raistrick et al., 2024 ) . For each scene, we render 16 16 views at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 resolution using Blender.

blocks.en: Training on canonical chunks. We train on individual canonical chunks so that local scene completion does not require processing an entire scene at once, which saves memory. During training, we normalize each scene to a common spatial range and extract overlapping chunks of side length L L . Geometry, depth, and camera translation are scaled consistently, preserving their image projections. Ground-truth depth and camera parameters provide conditioning during training, while monocular estimates replace them at inference. We optimize rank-32 LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2021 ) together with the new conditioning modules. At inference, each adaptive region is rescaled by 1 / a i 1/a_{i} into the same canonical domain seen during training.

blocks.en:
Autoregressive generation of a scene. Given an image, adaptive chunking determines where to generate.
We then generate the chunks sequentially, starting with chunks closer to the camera.
For each chunk, we map its latent cells into the shared scene frame and identify those already covered by the interior of previously generated chunks. Their latent values are then copied into the new chunk and re-imposed at every denoising step, so overlapping chunks agree by construction. Across depth regions, whose latent cells are of different sizes, we trilinearly resample the previous region’s latents at the new cell locations within the overlap and constrain them in the same way. We repeat this process over the allocated chunks and decode the assembled latents into the scene mesh.

blocks.en: Metrics. For datasets with ground-truth 3D geometry, including Tanks and Temples ( Knapitsch et al., 2017 ) and ScanNet++ ( Yeshwanth et al., 2023 ) , we evaluate geometric reconstruction using Chamfer Distance (CD) and F1 score. We represent both predictions and ground truth as point clouds. For methods that predict point clouds, we use the predicted points directly. For methods that predict meshes, we sample points from the surface using area-weighted sampling. For Lyra 2.0, we use the Gaussian centers as the predicted points. We similarly convert the ground-truth geometry to point clouds. Before computing the metrics, we use ICP to align each prediction with the ground truth. CD measures the geometric discrepancy between the prediction and ground truth. To make CD comparable across scenes with different scales, we normalize it by the median ground-truth depth. For F1, we use a distance threshold of 10 ​ cm 10\,\mathrm{cm} , where a predicted point is considered correct if it lies within 10 ​ cm 10\,\mathrm{cm} of the ground-truth surface.

We render the reconstructed scene from four viewpoints using surface normals and compute the similarity between the rendered and estimated normal maps. We conduct a user study using blind pairwise comparisons. Participants are shown an input image together with two reconstructed 3D scenes and asked to select the better reconstruction.

blocks.en: Conditioning mechanisms. We ablate different conditioning mechanisms in Tab. 3 . SAM 3D-style conditioning ( Chen et al., 2026a ) tokenizes the point maps and supplies them as additional tokens alongside the image tokens. Projection-only conditioning directly unprojects image features into 3D, similar to a plane-sweep volume. Our conditioning outperforms these alternatives on both the indoor and outdoor validation sets. From inspecting the reconstructed meshes, we observe that projection-only and SAM 3D-style conditioning more often produce duplicated surfaces and miss geometry in occluded regions. We hypothesize that explicitly associating each 3D token with both its corresponding image feature and its position relative to the observed surface makes the model easier to learn. The model no longer needs to implicitly infer the 2D–3D relationships through cross-attention or unprojected image features alone.

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 国家 结论

blocks.en:
We proposed a single-image scene mesh generation method to reconstruct indoor and outdoor scenes. Our method introduces adaptive scene chunks, explicit 2D–3D conditioning, and supervision from roughly 4,000 synthesized outdoor scenes to reconstruct observed surfaces and complete hidden geometry across indoor and outdoor environments. Experiments show that our method outperforms all baselines on indoor, outdoor, and in-the-wild scenes. A detailed ablation study validates the necessity of the proposed designs.
For future work, we plan to explore textured outputs, e.g . , 3D Gaussian splatting, finer geometric detail, and supporting more than one input image.

我们提出一个单一图像场景网格生成方法,以重建室内外景. 我们的方法引入了适应性的场景块,明确的2D-3D配置,以及从大约4000个合成室外场景的监控,重建所观测到的地表并完成室内外环境的隐藏几何. 实验表明,我们的方法在室内、室外和室内都超过了所有基线。 详细的消化研究证实了拟议设计的必要性。
对于今后的工作,我们计划探索有纹理的产出,例如: 三维高斯平板,更细的几何细节,以及支持多个输入图像.

Given an input image, we first use MoGE-3 ( Kong et al., 2026 ) to estimate the camera intrinsics and a 3D point map. We use these estimates to determine the scene’s physical size and placement of the chunks.
We define the scene coordinate frame by placing the origin at the ground-plane projection of the camera center, with + y +y pointing in the camera-forward direction and + z +z pointing upward. Following GenRecon ( Schmid et al., 2026 ) , we estimate the ground height using the 2 2 nd percentile of the point-cloud heights. We then construct a grid of overlapping chunks along both the camera-forward and lateral directions. For each depth row, we place enough chunks laterally to cover the corresponding range of the estimated point cloud, with neighboring chunks overlapping by 0.5 ​ m 0.5\,\mathrm{m} within the camera frustum. Consecutive depth rows also overlap by 0.5 ​ m 0.5\,\mathrm{m} .

blocks.en: Rather than globally rescaling the entire scene, we determine the chunk scale separately for each depth range. For a given range, if its 99 99 th-percentile height exceeds 2.8 ​ m 2.8\,\mathrm{m} , we increase the physical chunk size so that the corresponding geometry fits within the canonical 3 ​ m 3\,\mathrm{m} volume. Thus, only regions requiring additional spatial coverage are generated at a coarser physical resolution. The chunk size also increases progressively with depth: each new row is at least twice the size of the previous row, resulting in physical chunk sizes of 6 6 , 12 12 , 24 ​ m 24\,\mathrm{m} , and so on. The height criterion may further increase the scale when necessary, as shown in Fig. A1 . We continue adding rows until the grid reaches the 99 99 th-percentile depth of the estimated point cloud.

blocks.en: Chunking strategies comparison. Here, we compare the different chunking strategies in Fig. A2 on a large-scale scene extending to 280 ​ m 280\,\mathrm{m} in depth and 10 ​ m 10\,\mathrm{m} in height. Using fixed-size chunks at a uniform scale would require roughly 200 chunks, exceeding the memory capacity of an NVIDIA A100 (80GB). In contrast, our adaptive strategy covers the scene with only four depth regions and 15 chunks, requiring approximately 5 minutes of inference. Peak GPU memory usage is 26 26 GB, while generating a single chunk requires approximately 8 8 GB. Despite the reduced number of chunks, our method preserves fine geometry in nearby structures, such as the boats, while still covering large buildings in the distance. The single-chunk baseline runs in seconds, but compresses the entire scene into one canonical volume and consequently fails to recover meaningful scene geometry.

blocks.en: A.3. Limitations
blocks.zh: A.3. 限制

blocks.en: Our method generates scene geometry without textures. In addition, Trellis 2 does not guarantee watertight meshes, and our model inherits this limitation, occasionally producing holes that require additional mesh processing. Our method also relies on estimated depth and camera intrinsics, whose errors can affect chunk placement, scene scale, and feature alignment. Our autoregressive generation may propagate errors from earlier chunks to later ones through reused overlap latents.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法产生场景几何,没有纹理。 此外,Trellis 2不保证水密网,我们的模型继承了这一限制,偶尔会产生需要额外网状处理的孔. 我们的方法还依赖于估计的深度和相机的内在性能,其出错会影响块的布置,场景尺度,以及特征相接. 我们的自相递回的一代可能通过再利用的重叠潜质将错误从早期的块传播到以后的块.

blocks.en: A.4. Agentic framework for synthetic data generation
blocks.zh: A.4. 合成数据生成代理框架

blocks.en: Figure A5. Agentic framework for outdoor scene construction. Given an input image, (a) a VLM first produces a scene plan describing objects, their dimensions and spatial relations, and ground regions. (b) Each visible object is cropped from the image, completed to recover occluded geometry, and reconstructed into a 3D mesh. (c) Ground geometry is recovered from the estimated point map, semantic layout, and height map. (d) A layout solver places the reconstructed assets while satisfying spatial constraints and avoiding collisions. (e) A VLM critic iteratively inspects the assembled scene and proposes corrections to object placement and missing content, producing the final 3D scene.
blocks.zh: 图A5. 户外场景建筑的活性框架. 考虑到输入图像,(a) VLM首先产生一个场景计划,描述物体、其尺寸和空间关系以及地面区域。 (b) 每个可见物体从图像上被收割,完成取回所覆盖的几何,再重建为3D网格。 (c) 从估计点图、语义布局和高地图中恢复地貌几何。 (d) 排版解决器在满足空间限制和避免相撞的同时放置被重建的资产。 (e) 一个VLM评论员迭代地检查集合的场景,并提议对物体放置和缺失内容进行更正,从而产生最后的3D场景。

blocks.en:
Fig. A5 summarizes our agentic framework for constructing outdoor training scenes.
We first use GPT-5.6 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) to generate 4000 prompts describing diverse outdoor scenes from 20 categories: city streets, parks and gardens, suburban houses, landmarks, and so on. Then we use Ideogram ( AI, 2026 ) to generate a reference image. Given each image, GPT-5.6 outputs a scene plan containing object categories, approximate object dimensions, spatial relations, and ground regions.
For object reconstruction, GPT-5.6 localizes each object in the image with a bounding box. We crop each detected object and use Nano Banana ( Google DeepMind, 2025 ) to complete its occluded regions, producing an image of the full object. Trellis 2 then converts the completed object image into a 3D mesh.
blocks.zh:
发相. 第5条概述了我们建造户外训练场景的代理框架。
我们首先使用GPT-5.6(OpenAI, 2026)生成4000个提示来描述来自20个类别的不同户外场景:城市街道,公园和花园,郊区住宅,地标等. 后使用Ideogram(AI,2026)来生成参考图像. 根据每个图像,GPT-5.6输出一个场景计划,其中包含对象类别,大致对象维度,空间关系,和地面区域.
对于对象重建,GPT-5.6用边框将图像中的每个对象本地化. 我们用纳米香蕉(Google DeepMind, 2025年)来完成所覆盖的区域, Trellis 2 然后将完成的对象图像转换为3D网格.

blocks.en:
Following WorldClaw ( Guo et al., 2026 ) , we reconstruct the ground separately. MoGE-3 converts the image into a top-view representation, and Nano Banana then predicts a ground-layout map over this top view. GPT-5.6 additionally predicts terrain parameters for each ground region, which we convert into a height map. We combine the layout and height map to construct the final terrain.
We then assemble the scene using a search-based layout solver following SAGE10k ( Xia et al., 2026 ) . For each object, the solver searches over discrete ground positions and rotations, rejects placements that introduce object overlap, and scores the candidates according to how well they satisfy the spatial relations specified in the scene plan. After placement, we run a physics simulation to place the objects onto the reconstructed terrain.
blocks.zh:
追随世界 克劳(郭等,2026年),我们分别重建地. MoGE-3将图像转换为上视图代表,纳诺·巴纳纳随后在这个上视图上预言出地平图. GPT-5.6另外预测了每个地块的地形参数,我们将其转换为高地图. 我们把布局图和高度图结合起来 来构建最后的地形
然后我们用一个基于搜索的布局解析器在SAGE10k(Xia等,2026年)之后组装现场. 对于每个物体,解答者在离散地姿势和旋转上进行搜索,拒绝引入物体重叠的放置,并根据其满足场景计划所指定的空间关系的程度对考生进行评分. 放置后,我们进行物理模拟, 将物体放置在重建的地上。

blocks.en: To improve scene-level consistency with the reference image, we perform one refinement round using GPT-5.6 as a VLM critic. The critic compares the reference image against a top-view rendering and four corner-view renderings of the assembled scene. It identifies missing objects and incorrect spatial relations and updates the scene plan accordingly, after which we rerun the layout solver. The final scene is then used as the final outdoor dataset.
blocks.zh: 为了提高场景级别与参考图像的一致性,我们用GPT-5.6作为VLM评论员进行一回合的改进. 评论家将参考图像与上视渲染和集合场景的4个角景渲染相提并论. 它识别出缺失的物体和不正确的空间关系,并相应更新场景计划,之后我们重新运行布局解析器. 最后的场景随后被作为最后的室外数据集.
